Udyogini Scheme

Details

Udyogini Scheme supports women entrepreneurs in Karnataka with training and financial assistance for micro-enterprises through designated channels.

Benefits

Eligible women may receive subsidy support and facilitation for enterprise setup as notified by the implementing department.

Eligibility

Women applicants meeting age and income criteria notified by the Karnataka implementing agency may apply. Exact criteria are published officially.

Application Process

Apply through the notified Karnataka department portal or facilitation centres with the required documents and consent forms.

Documents Required

  • Identity proof (Aadhaar)
  • Address proof
  • Bank account details
